description.sub_name: 政府數位治理與人工智慧專題
description.sub_ename: TOPIC ON GOVERNMENT DIGITAL GOVERNANCE AND AI
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在提升學生對人工智慧與大數據分析在政府數位治理中的應用理解及政策思辨能力，涵蓋數位政府、資料治理、開放資料、公民科技參與、資訊安全及AI倫理等核心議題。課程探討AI技術對行政效率、公共透明度及政策設計的影響，並與公務人員高考所需的數位素養銜接。學生將學習如何評估科技政策的可行性與公共價值，並掌握跨域治理、數位轉型及AI監理政策等關鍵能力，為未來從事政策研究及數位治理推動奠定基礎。
description.describe_eh: This course teaches students how AI and big data are used in government services. As more governments start using digital tools, students will look at real-life examples from both national and local governments. They will learn about topics like online government services, sharing data with the public, getting citizens involved, keeping data safe, and making sure AI is used in a fair way. This course is especially helpful for students who want to take government exams or work in public service in the future.
